title: What Lurks in the Asteroid Belt?

script: Did you know Earth is hit by space rocks every single day? Most burn up harmlessly, but millions of asteroids lurk in our solar system, leftover debris from the birth of planets. The largest, Ceres, is actually classified as a dwarf planet! Scientists track thousands of these near-Earth objects using advanced telescopes, calculating their orbits decades in advance to keep us safe. While a catastrophic impact is extremely unlikely anytime in our lifetimes, studying asteroids helps us unlock the ancient secrets of our cosmic neighborhood. Space is vast, and these rocky wanderers are its time capsules.
